app_release_notes: v1.6.0 - Type in velocities by hand and edit any value on the Confirm page. Reading your chronograph is smoother (faster detection + a progress meter) and now starts clean, so older sessions can't mix into a new ladder and land on the wrong charge. Your Load Card shows the range-day temperature and notes. Trackpad scrolling no longer changes a dropdown or number by accident. Plus wizard and Measure polish.

windows.app_release_notes: v1.5.4 - Plugging in a Garmin Xero now reads your sessions on Windows and Apple Silicon Macs. The "read it right off the chronograph" feature was turning the .FIT files away on those computers; now it imports them the way it always did on Intel Macs.
